csv_project_name: Architectural Svc for Batmale Hall Modernization
csv_scope_of_work: The San Francisco Community College District, also known locally as City College of San Francisco, Office of Facilities Planning and Construction (hereinafter District") is announcing a Request for Proposals (RFP) from pre-qualified architectural firms (hereinafter architectural firm) to submit proposals to provide architectural and engineering services for the Batmale Hall Modernization project at Ocean Campus. The scope of services of the selected architectural firm will be to lead a team of design consultants in all facets of design, engineering, administration, estimating and related areas of expertise required to undertake DSA-approved modernization of Batmale Hall to address District needs and to comply with District policies and standards. The scope of services will include, but not be limited to, working with District staff from Facilities, Buildings and Grounds, Academic & Instructional Affairs, Finance & Administration and Student Affairs.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering
